completeExactAcceptedRecord.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes WIS. Success establishes nothing. KEEP failure loses one round in confusion. NEW on a failed save, if actual defenses permit and the shared hard-control allowance is unused, establish a custom lost-round state immediately until the end of the target’s next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn. There is no concentration; this ongoing rank-4 rider expressly survives the original Instantaneous metadata and is subject to qualifying removal/suppression. It prohibits new full Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and voluntary movement commitments. Already legally committed Actions/Reactions finish their actual resolution; movement already spent is not refunded, while later uncommitted movement cannot begin. Extra turns inside the interval gain no exception and do not shorten the endpoint. The target still makes actual required saves, death saves and ending checks, can perceive/think and use permitted speech, retains passive defenses and can be moved by independent forces. This is not Stunned, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, Blinded or the ordinary Confusion spell; it imposes no automatic failed saves, attack advantage, forced hostile attack or concentration loss by itself. Ordinary damage or a separately applicable incapacitating state still affects concentration normally. Apply the shared future attached-phase/six-second bridge where the recipient has no regular turn, without inventing a companion turn. Consume the source-character/target/encounter guard only on establishment; an already spent guard or relevant immunity blocks this entire lost-round state, with no replacement penalty. Charmed-only immunity does not cover a rider that imposes no Charmed condition; actual broader defenses apply. Suppression permits whatever normal actions are otherwise legal while suppressed, without restoring budgets already spent or extending the endpoint. The used hard-control allowance remains used after early removal or suppression. No repeat save is added; expiry/removal/death of the recipient ends the rider. No teleportation or stopped personal time occurs.

completeExactAcceptedRecord.procedure:
KEEP both source placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and concentration up to one minute. NEW choose one willing creature, including yourself, perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. The casting range selects that recipient; a separate NEW 60-foot sensory extent moves with its actual body. Combine both preserved placements' explicit benefits into this single identity: darkness, all illusions, invisibility, shapechanges and transmutations. This proposed union does not grant an unacquired school or class mode. There is no save for a willing recipient, and the benefit requires no continuing range tether to the caster.

Within the extent and actual unobstructed sensory path, the recipient sees normally through ordinary or magical darkness, sees actually Invisible creatures/objects, and perceives sensory illusions as identifiable false overlays. Darkness removal is observer-specific and casts no light for others. It does not penetrate actual opaque barriers, physical smoke/fog or opaque mundane material. Blinded or missing usable sight still prevents sight; darkness alone is bypassed, not the Blinded condition. Normal hearing or another genuinely functioning sense can identify an illusory sound/tactile impression whose actual apparent source lies within the extent and accessible sensory path, without gaining hearing while Deafened or receiving messages through walls. An existing remote sensor does not acquire this effect or move its extent; its own express sharing rules must supply any separate permission.

NEW the recipient sees the underlying original appearance beneath an actually operative shapechange/transmutation, including an ongoing permanent form spell. The body remains in its current mechanical form with its actual HP, anatomy, equipment and permissions. This reveals appearance only, not a name, history, alignment, motives, creature statistics, identity documents or lost earlier transformations. A completed instantaneous conversion that now leaves ordinary matter supplies no ongoing false form to pierce. Seeing an original silhouette does not find hidden objects inside the body or restore missing matter. Physical concealment/Hidden still needs ordinary detection; an invisible creature is not automatically found through cover. Once genuinely seen, its Invisible-specific unseen modifiers are bypassed for this observer within the benefit's scope.

For current visual illusions, this is conclusive personal identification without an examination Action. Identification removes only perception-dependent deception and any consequence whose own source explicitly ends on disbelief. It does not dispel the source for other observers or cancel an independently specified psychic packet, fear relation or compulsion. NEW explicit bridge to the unadopted Mental Prison proposal: a recipient seeing through its own subjective prison leaves that illusion mentally; the prison's one still-live ordinary exit packet resolves under its own rule, rather than treating True Seeing as antimagic. Greater Phantasmal Killer's independent damage proposal and Spectral Army's explicit detonation remain capable of damage. These cross-proposal choices await joint review. Concentration ending, expiry, actual removal or recipient death ends this sight. Suppression suspends it while the clock continues. Separate True Seeing sources add no range and retain independent endings; renewed paid casts grant no new knowledge beyond present actual perception.

Saves are binary, without natural-die degree shifts. No generic upcast, level scaling, extra turn or unacquired source is supplied.

IP14-SOURCE1-clocks.completeText: NEW for these cards, durations expressed in minutes/hours use absolute elapsed deadlines from resolution: one minute is sixty seconds and one hour is 3,600 seconds. Expiry precedes a use scheduled at exactly that deadline. A hostile one-round rider uses the first future target regular END excluding the in-progress turn; N future target-end installments use precisely N such endpoints. Outside initiative use the stated 6N seconds. Preserve the chosen virtual marker or absolute deadline through reordering, extra turns, absence, entry and exit from initiative. NEW attached-asset bridge for Mind Maze and Leeching Plague: if the recipient has only a real original-owner attached phase, use its next future attached-phase END excluding a phase already underway; if it has no real turn/phase, use six-second END-only checkpoints. Mapping a checkpoint supplies no ordinary turn, Action, death save, refresh or extra tick. Due effects run before their own ending cleanup. Suppressed scheduled installments are spent without effect; they never accumulate.

IP14-SOURCE1-identityAndMultiplicity.completeText: NEW explicit group default: one active instance per original caster per ordinary spell ID; a successfully established replacement ends only that caster’s old active instance. An invalid or countered nonconcentration cast leaves the old instance, while ordinary concentration displacement still happens at commitment. A successfully resisted cast establishes nothing and does not replace an old nonconcentration rider. Different owners keep separate source records and endpoints, with stated same-family caps and the existing strongest same-stat flat-bonus rules. Do not generalize that bonus rule into a universal strongest-effect rule. Each record retains caster, class, rank, cast ID, snapshotted spell DC, recipients/anchor, actual history and ending. Transfer, form change or a new database ID cannot rearm it. Nonconcentration voluntary dismissal here requires the original caster’s Action and perception/line of effect to the recipient or anchor within original range; completed instantaneous consequences cannot be recalled.

IP14-SOURCE1-perceptionAndIllusions.completeText: KEEP actual sight, hearing, Hidden, cover and Invisible rules. Ordinary invisibility does not hide location automatically. Once an observer knows location, it loses only Invisible-specific attack advantage/disadvantage; sight-required targeting still requires actual sight. Resolve a revealing attack first, then give location knowledge only to observers perceiving its evidence. Alternate senses work only within their real scope. NEW apply the current LR-G07 examination procedure to these new visual illusions: an Action with a relevant accessible sense permits INT (Investigation) against the creating spell’s snapshotted DC, using Core degrees/natural shifts then collapsing Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure. Failure permits another attempt only with genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive personally witnessed physical contradiction identifies the false part without a roll. A warning enables examination but does not globally identify the spell for everybody. Images add no actual cover, collision, support, light, sound, creature body, remote senses or inventory unless expressly supplied below. No compelled belief, automatic disguise success or knowledge of hidden terrain is granted.

IP14-SOURCE1-hardControlAndMovement.completeText: KEEP the source-character/target/encounter hard-denial allowance shared across that owner’s effects. Soft Speed effects, an obstacle and a numeric attack/save penalty do not themselves spend it. Teleportation relocates without spending Speed, traversing the path or provoking ordinary opportunity attacks. Speed 0 alone is not a relocation prohibition; an actual teleport/relocation prohibition still applies. Verify whole body, actual legal cargo, occupancy and destination before resolution. Only actual carried noncreature belongings travel unless a card expressly permits passengers; another creature, grappled victim, carried living body or mount stays with its own real position/support. No route between planes, custody bypass, resource refill or returned movement budget is implied.

IP14-SOURCE1-assetsAndControl.completeText: KEEP the real owner-wide one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round. Commands use the owner’s Bonus Action on their regular turn, actual audible/visible communication within sixty feet, and execute in the attached phase after that whole turn. No immediate creation movement/attack and no extra-turn refresh. An issued command survives later owner incapacity only while the actual source and other eligibility survive. Uncommanded assets can move defensively and Dodge, subject to conditions. Current owner-source PB supplies saves; specified base HP/AC remain fixed except genuinely acquired source-qualified modifiers. No borrowed monster abilities or unstated condition/damage immunity. For the two NEW summoned bodies below and Bone Cage only, full suppression of that creating source ends that body/structure immediately rather than storing an intangible replacement. Actual riders or narrowly scoped suppression still affect only their own scope. Ending drops actual cargo/riders at their actual locations with ordinary support/Falling; it creates no salvage, corpse, duplicate equipment or reappearance. This explicit NEW ending rule does not amend other summons.

IP14-SOURCE1-damageHealingAndCosts.completeText: KEEP typed damage defenses, actual prevention/sharing, buffers, life-state rules, Wounds and concentration. Save-half floors before the relevant defenses. Numeric actualDamageDealt is temporary HP absorbed plus actual normal HP lost, excluding overkill and prevented HP-floor loss. For a permitted drain sum eligible terminal recipient branches once, never both a split parent and its children; apply the card’s narrower funding predicate before its final half/floor. HP restoration uses actual healing restrictions and maximums and grants no automatic Wound cure, resurrection or resource refresh. Direct HP payment is separate from damage: no resistance, buffer, transfer, Wound/damage trigger or damage-derived refund. It must be paid from real normal HP under the card’s explicit floor. No necrotic, shadow, plague or soul name creates an unprinted condition, material, pool or setting fact.

IP14-SOURCE2-casting.completeText: Retain every actual rank-six/base 13 RP class access row and school: Illusion ordinarily Wizard 11, Bard/Mirrorsage 16, Crimson Agent 19; Necromancy Cleric/Druid/Wizard 11, Shaman 16, Crimson Agent 19. True Seeing retains its separate actual Divination/Illusion rows. All retain Action, range 60 feet and V/S/F except Invisible Tide range 30 feet and Blood Fog/Circle of Death V/S/M-or-F. For those two use the existing unpriced ordinary material/focus alternative, without inventing a consumed reagent or price. Actual repertoire, source ability, components, RP modifiers, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transitions and interrupt rules apply. IP14-SOURCE2-geometry.completeText: Declare modes, legal perceived centers and named targets before hidden resolution. Caster-to-center/target line of effect is required; areas also require center-to-recipient line of effect. An indiscriminate area does not require separately seeing each recipient and includes allies/self unless its card says otherwise. Fixed spheres have their stated three-dimensional radii, not diameter or distance from the caster. Opaque physical barriers remain real. A subjective enemy predicate uses the caster's actual existing knowledge and hostility toward that creature, not secret alignment, allegiance or an extra detection sense. An already-known enemy can be affected while currently unseen; an entirely unknown creature is not automatically classified as hostile by this spell.

IP14-SOURCE2-clocks.completeText: NEW cohort bindings: one minute is 60 elapsed seconds from resolution. Expiry wins at its exact deadline. Regular START/END means the actual ordinary turn, never an extra turn. END-only ending saves include a current regular turn's upcoming END; outside initiative they occur every six seconds after application and the first unresolved opportunity maps to the next actual regular END on entering initiative. Original deadlines and spent events persist through initiative changes, absence and suppression. A companion-only recipient uses its actual original-owner regular attached phase START/END for an expressly assigned spell tick/save, without generating a regular turn, refresh or death save; if that phase is absent use the original six-second spell-only schedule. This NEW bridge supplies only the card's due effect/save, never a companion Action. Compelled movement uses only a real available movement phase. Suppressed opportunities are lost, not queued; resumption grants no immediate periodic packet.

IP14-SOURCE2-illusions.completeText: Use the current LR-G07 procedure for a sensory image: a personally accessible relevant sense and an Action permit INT (Investigation) against the original spell DC, with Core task degrees/natural shifts. Informed observers perceive through the identified false sensory overlay using their actual senses. exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: After the Sundering the Spiral entered a lull that felt almost like peace, yet every thread knew that calm marked only the prelude to transformation. The Divine Pact, fresh from its ordeal, hummed low beneath the lattice, evaluating every resonance for signs of fracture. Calan’thir drifted along the main corridor, listening with renewed care. Where once two guardians had shared that watch, there now stood seven virtues and a distant inferno that never slept. Harmony and discord remained entwined, but the texture of the Weave had shifted. Possibility began to crystallize into realms that would hold their own gravity and their own ambitions. The first sparks of true differentiation flared at nexus points where the pressure of sealed silence met the stamina of Choir light. Tiny bubbles of substance formed, each carrying a singular inclination. One bubble blazed with relentless heat, another sighed with curling mist, a third shimmered with lucid fragments of dream, a fourth vibrated with questions that chased their own tails. The Weave, curious and confident, granted space for these newborn concentrations to expand. As they grew, Choir members guided their motion, ensuring that no single infant realm consumed its siblings before individuality matured.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: During this delicate phase Calan’thir moved as silent shepherd, coaxing resonance into borders that would resist collapse. Pattern drew geometric scaffolds, Balance adjusted densities, Courage braced weak walls with golden light, Sorrow infused compassion so that growth would not devour itself, Law laid protocols that would one day become natural law, Contradiction injected healthy uncertainty, and Transition shaped gateways through which energy could circulate. Slowly the bubbles solidified into vast dominions with breathtaking landscapes still unvisited. At the outer rim Asmodeus felt the newborn realms through the tether that bound his empire of consequence to the Spiral. Though his heart remained focused on endless war, he understood that fresh seats of power meant fresh variables to exploit. He ordered watchers crafted from infernal glass to chart the glow of each budding plane. Their reports confirmed future opportunity, but for now the planes flourished beyond his immediate reach.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Of all emergent realms, the one born from roaring conflagration expanded fastest. The Bastion of Flame opened within days of cosmic measure, unfurling molten spires that curved like dragon horns across a sky the color of ember. Seas of liquid metal surged along fault lines, carving trenches that breathed white fire into the air. At the realm’s heart rose the Crucible Citadel, a mountain of incandescent basalt crowned by a corona of living sparks. Every element in this dominion possessed will to burn, not merely to destroy, but to purify anything it touched into brighter version of itself. Calan’thir dispatched Courage and Law to anchor early growth, aware that unbridled purification could scorch the Spiral’s corridor if left unchecked. Courage raised bulwarks where seas threatened to overflow into adjoining aether, and Law engraved runic veins that directed rivers of lava into planned channels. The flame welcomed structure so long as it intensified heat. An accord formed between volcanic fervor and ordered flow, ensuring that raw wrath tempered into forge rather than wildfire.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Uncounted eons later, mortal smiths would claim their greatest inspirations came from visions of glowing pillars witnessed in prophetic trance. They would never know they glimpsed the Bastion’s birth cry. At this moment only Choir and Weave observed, etching every dance of magma into cosmic memory. Beyond the Spiral Asmodeus studied the reports of his glass watchers, intrigued by a realm that loved both fury and structure. He whispered to generals in Nessus of future alliances, though none could yet grasp purpose. For now, the Bastion continued to blaze, its song a chord of cleansing heat that strengthened the overall resonance of the seal. Opposite the Bastion’s relentless glare coalesced a realm of hushed twilight known as the Veiled Expanse. It began as single curl of mist that refused to disperse. Instead the mist thickened, layering upon itself until sight and sound folded inward. Where fire sought to strip away impurity, shadow sought to unmake certainty. Rolling banks of fog drifted across obsidian plains that devoured footprints an instant after passage. Islands of faint starlight floated above the haze, each star a memory captured and hidden from prying eyes.
exactOriginalNavigationPassages.purpose: Exact navigation excerpt; full original DOCX supplied. Neither source prose nor excerpt creates an operational plane/time rule.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Choir responsibility for this realm fell chiefly to Balance and Sorrow. Balance moderated expansion, preventing the Expanse from siphoning too much luminosity from neighboring regions. Sorrow walked its silent valleys, drawing faint reflections of grief into gentle channels so the realm’s hunger would manifest as contemplation rather than absolute void. Over time the Veiled Expanse became refuge for secrets too fragile for daylight. Within its mists histories slept until ready for retelling. The Old Ones beneath the Spiral felt kinship with that hush, but the Choir’s careful oversight ensured the similarity remained distant. The Expanse honored silence, yet retained structured heartbeat of the Weave. So long as that rhythm persisted, hush could not exploit kinship to rise again. Asmodeus considered the Expanse with cautious respect. Complete erasure of distinction lay counter to his law of consequence. Still, secrets empowered leverage. He assigned subtle devils to learn every eddy of mist, but none returned with clear maps, only half remembered impressions. His desire for dominance grew keener. Between fire and shadow blossomed a realm woven from possibility itself, a place where images held weight and stories stepped forward as living actors. The Radiant Currents formed from the dreamlike bubble mentioned earlier, but when stability settled, the bubble did not crystallize into static land. It instead unfolded into endless archipelagos of light suspended in flowing rivers of prismatic luminescence. Each island lasted only while someone, somewhere, imagined it, then dissolved back into current, giving way to next sequence of inspired creation.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Pattern and Transition lavished attention upon this fluid dominion. Pattern ensured that even spontaneous visions obeyed underlying harmonic grids, preventing collapse into incoherent noise. Transition nurtured gateways through which finished dreams might drift onward, perhaps to mortal minds not yet formed, perhaps to halls of Dungeon awaiting novel challenge. Courage visited seldom, for courage found little traction in lands that whirled faster than fear could take hold. Sorrow, however, wandered here often, absorbing echoes of hope that sparkled ephemeral before vanishing. Within Radiant Currents, time folded unpredictably. Calan’thir noted that echoes of events not yet occurred sometimes danced on distant ripples. Such flares provided glimpses of futures that may be, though interpretation required wisdom. Choir stored these flickers in Crystal Bastion memory cores for later reflection. To Asmodeus, the Currents represented both bounty and threat. Inspiration could seed ambition, yet malleability defied rigid hierarchy. He temporarily left realm to its motion, marking it as potential recruiting ground for rare demons who could imagine structure rather than simply crave violence.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: The fourth great realm matured within a hollow ring of curving lightning that glowed violet white. Inside that ring shimmered vast emptiness where ideas formed entire celestial bodies made from logic, syllogism, and question. Observers likened the space to library without walls where every scroll wrote itself while being read. The Void embraced inquiry that never reached final answer. Each answer, once approached, splintered into new riddles that drifted deeper toward core. This dominion fell under stewardship of Pattern, Law, and Contradiction in equal measure. Pattern archived the evolution of reasoning, Law tracked chains of premise and conclusion, Contradiction prevented stasis by challenging every theorem. Balance supplied occasional anchor, nudging explorers away from obsession. Within centuries of cosmic measure, grand constellations shaped like fractal polyhedral rotated across thought sky, each node a philosophical school debating its own structure. The Weave loved such fertile uncertainty because it produced vibrations that kept hush attentive yet perplexed. Silence found no foothold in questions that multiplied faster than stillness could freeze them. Calan’thir often visited to refresh perspective, listening to philosophers carved of radiant glyphs argue over nature of music, edge, and void.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Asmodeus dispatched spies to trace logical currents, seeking axioms that might justify conquest for greater good. Some spies returned with paradoxes that unraveled upon inspection, others with insights that strengthened infernal contracts. Thus even the Boundless Void fed the Infernal Conflict indirectly. With four primary dominions established, interplay commenced. Fiery emissaries crossed burning marches into Dream waters, where heat cooled into gem glows that authors in Radiant Currents employed to craft stories about heroic smiths. Shifting mists from the Veiled Expanse rolled onto borders of Boundless Void, cloaking debates in fresh uncertainty and birthing new dialectic branches. Rivers of lucid rainbow from Dream streamed into basalt ravines of Bastion, tempering magma so that crimson glass flowers blossomed along lava banks.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Each exchange required guidance to prevent absorption or unintended fusion. Choir members managed diplomatic corridors called Confluence Straits. Every Strait matched virtue with realm synergy. Balance oversaw Straits between fire and shadow, ensuring one never quenched or consumed the other. Transition supervised Straits joining Dream and Thought, facilitating passage of ideas into narratives and return of narratives as distilled wisdom. Courage patrolled any Strait where destructive volatility spiked, ready to stand unyielding so that conversation did not shift into conquest. The Dungeon, ever mirroring cosmic tide, produced new chambers that reflected these exchanges. Explorers would later discover rooms where magma columns whispered riddles, or fog murals revealed blazing prophecies in negative image. Some levels rewrote themselves nightly following debates in Boundless Void. Through these resonant hallways mortals would one day encounter puzzles designed not merely to challenge might, but to test their ability to integrate opposites without dissipating purpose.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Though exiled, Asmodeus never abandoned ambition to steer cosmic structure. Observing interplay he recognized that as realms traded essence, dependences formed. He reasoned that a single decisive act in correct region could send shock across entire lattice, eventually loosening Choir influence. Yet direct invasion risked repeating Sundering disaster. He chose subtler path. From Nessus he forged crystalline seeds laced with infernal law, each seed small enough to hide in dream, strong enough to germinate into contracts. He delivered seeds through cracks opened by demonic assaults on devil fortresses. Some seeds drifted on dream current into Radiant archipelagos, embedding themselves in narrative soil. Others clung to questioning winds and settled on edges of Boundless Void debates. When local intelligences discovered them, seeds offered bargains: clarity in exchange for obedience, strength in exchange for vow. A few guardians sensed foreign resonance. Balance felt faint tilt in Straits flow. Pattern noticed irregular recursion. Yet infiltration remained under threshold. Calan’thir detected only soft prick of wrongness but could not yet trace source. The Weave permitted these intrusions, perhaps considering them necessary test of new realms. Discord, after all, fueled vigilance.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: As four pillars matured, tributary realms budded along their borders. Where Bastion heat met Dream flux, realm of Molten Glass Tapestries emerged, landscapes that cooled into intricate murals each dawn then melted by dusk. Along boundary of Veiled Expanse and Dream, realm named Luminous Dusk formed, twilight meadows haunted by memories seeking closure. Between Shadow and Thought coalesced Whispering Archive, an endless shelf of sealed memories that question their own veracity. At confluence of Fire and Thought erupted Calculated Pyre, eternal engine burning problems to reveal numeric ash. Choir welcomed these children, assigning newly formed lesser spirits as custodians. Each spirit carried spark of one virtue, diluted but focused, tasked with maintaining balance inside its small dominion. The Weave expanded administrative lattice to track relationships. Calan’thir rejoiced quietly, seeing proof that Spiral could evolve beyond crisis into creativity.

exactOriginalNavigationPassages.text: Yet every new branch increased complexity, presenting gaps through which hush might seep. To address risk, Pattern drafted great schema linking all plane frequencies into overarching cadence. Courage and Sorrow acted as pillars anchoring farthest extremes, while Contradiction wove tolerance for paradox into central hub. Law sealed plan with charter recognized by Pact yet free of Asmodeus seal. This grand map would guide future calibrations. While grand realms found shape, fragments of Source energy near prison coalesced into first mortal souls on world called Aethel. These souls shimmered fragile, ignorant of cosmic war, yet their resonance chimed perfectly with newborn planes. A child’s fearless laughter resonated with Courage pillar in Bastion. An elder’s whispered regret drifted through Sorrow’s gardens in Veiled Expanse. A scholar’s restless curiosity soared across Boundless Void.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original Cosmology/Matrix/surviving World manuscripts precede later interpretation; owner update02 resolves the earlier source-preference ambiguity. Planes review is bounded, not a completed ontology. The saved website is preserved source, not a metric map.
options: Retain originals, exact owner corrections and separately scoped accepted mechanics; leave unproved realm identities open.
Promote later terminology or map proximity into objective realm equivalence.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend the first option. No Shadowfell=Veiled Expanse, Void=entity, natural-origin or afterlife inference. Mechanical generated-space IDs can be new scoped authorship without naming a canonical plane.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Native access, Action/120ft/V,S,F/21RP and original duration fields are preserved. Dimensional Anchor, Planar Barrier, Banishment and Faction Portal have different exact transport rules.
options: Classify each spell operation explicitly: creation, portal connection, physical crossing, planar displacement, tether and mandatory ending.
Treat every planar-tagged effect as teleportation or reuse one global block/return rule.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend per-operation source classifications, ordinary paid/counter timing and atomic body/custody handling. Specify known preflight versus hidden paid failure without giving a hidden-state diagnostic. Banishment terminal exceptions are not automatically inherited.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original realm prose includes unusual time and the owner defines primordial Cycle as an age; neither supplies a gameplay clock conversion. Opening/Horn/Hunt and independent source deadlines already exist.
options: Keep actual elapsed deadlines and existing source clocks; label any different spell-local clock as a separately reviewed exception.
Infer stasis, rest refresh, Hunt avoidance or time acceleration from realm lore.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend unchanged real clocks and source-specific resource/rest permissions. Preserve geography bypass where an actual route allows it, while not automatically completing Extraction or changing Hunt/death/cargo records.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Both actual rank8 placements promise creation of a private extradimensional space/room; actual class grants remain Conjuration. No room dimensions, boundary material or entry geometry are printed.
options: Author a bounded persistent room with explicit dimensions, support, environmental behavior and one actual access interface.
Make only a temporary Banishment-sized cell or silently import another game’s Demiplane.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain a useful actual private room. GPT must select explicit NEW dimensions/capacity and entry geometry, including all-body fit and mandatory anatomy changes. Ephemeral boundaries must not become free saleable raw materials; supplies and furniture retain actual sources.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core120ft/Instantaneous describes creation but gives no door duration, directionality, admission credential, remote view or later re-entry.
options: Separate persistent room identity from a finite connection; define full local/remote entry predicates and later reopening.
Treat privacy as absolute invulnerability or grant arbitrary remote entry into any named space.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit NEW entrance duration, actual movement cost, one/two-way choice, permitted users and reopening by the actual room’s retained identity. Publicly seeing a doorway is not necessarily owning its key. No secret-plane location oracle, unprinted attack passage or automatic remote line of effect.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Create a room does not specify one room per caster, replacement of older rooms, abandoned rooms or what happens to stored living creatures and cargo.
options: Choose a finite active-space ownership rule while preserving exact occupants, objects and lawful transfers; never overwrite a nonempty room.
Silently delete an older room and its contents on recast/death or duplicate stored inventories.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a bounded explicit room/connection registry with stable IDs, actual ownership and deterministic handling of old rooms on recast, death and save/load. Resolve persistent useful storage without making repeated casts unlimited free physical stock. Different casters cannot inherit access by name alone.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Banishment closes on suppression with a scoped terminal-return exception; Faction Portal instead suppresses access until its original deadline. Neither defines Demiplane.
options: Choose separate suppression/dispelling behavior for room and connection, with deterministic settlement of every extant identity.
Borrow whichever earlier ending avoids a hard case without an explicit scoped extension.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend expressly decide whether inaccessible rooms persist and what true room removal does. A closing door never bisects transit. Define actual origins/anchors for visitors born, summoned or transferred inside; no unseen deletion, arbitrary tactical relocation or indefinite imprisonment caused only by a failed placement operation.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A private extradimensional room does not establish its native inhabitants, souls, safe-rest immunity, relation to the Heartcell or website rings.
options: Use a newly generated spell-space only with bounded privacy and real ongoing creature/effect records.
Assign canonical plane, divine sanctuary, afterlife, protected rest or new native population from its name.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend generated opaque plane/space references and explicitly limited ordinary information/travel interfaces. Any actual escape, summons, rest or resource refill requires its own source. Keep original cosmology open and preserve campaign disclosure boundaries.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Both Illusion8 and Universal8 say trap a creature in an extradimensional labyrinth. Core gives no save or concentration and prints Instantaneous. This is not Mind Maze’s subjective display.
options: Author a genuine extradimensional captivity application with explicit initial resistance, hard-control admission and duration.
Reduce the spell to an observer-private illusion or import an unstated external Maze rule.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain real labyrinth displacement and actual agency, preserving both placements and current class-school access. GPT must select NEW save/automatic admission choice, concentration and finite maximum; encounter-removal uses the accepted hard-control gate only where explicitly applicable.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The labyrinth promise requires a real navigable challenge, but no topology, dimensions, exit condition, INT check or automatic species escape is printed.
options: Define deterministic generated topology/seed and a finite ordinary navigation/escape procedure, including small and large bodies.
Use an abstract roll that makes the labyrinth irrelevant or silently give named creatures automatic escape.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend an executable finite labyrinth with explicit passages, whole-body fit, movement and escape interaction; any check costs, DC, cadence or species privilege are NEW. No regeneration may invalidate visited routes without a stated rule. Preserve meaningful choices and actual action costs.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No printed rule describes freedom, source suppression, concentration loss, death, corpses, later visitors or expiry inside Maze.
options: Specify a complete closure/escape lifecycle and real body/object placement with bounded source-specific exceptions.
Leave permanent sealed survivors or reuse Banishment’s exceptions without review.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend define terminal return/anchor and settlement for every genuine occupant and object, preserving escaped identities, deaths, source expiry and carried creatures. A source ending never duplicates lost gear or revives a dead target; physical conflict cannot silently extend the effect.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual Dimensional Door is same-plane only; Faction Portal may reach a qualifying real headquarters on another plane; accepted True Seeing distinguishes subjective mental effects from physical geometry.
options: Apply each actual escape, information and suppression source by its exact predicate; a real maze remains physically real.
Let True Seeing universally dispel it or assume every teleport escapes it.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit access/knowledge/range/plane/body checks. Keep Maze distinct from accepted Mind Maze and Mental Prison. A named school does not make real walls false or grant immunity. Resolve suppression of target, connection and source separately.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source does not specify recasting on an absent target, independent prisoners, shared labyrinths or concurrent caster ownership.
options: Choose one bounded application/space policy with actual perceived targets and original clocks.
Allow hidden absent-target selection, unlimited nested realms or recast-based imprisonment refresh.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend stable per-application identity, explicit replacement/nesting handling and no free target knowledge. Disclose whether separate captives ever share space and how visitors create closure metadata; decide without revising canonical realm identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Close ALL connections to a SPECIFIC plane WITHIN1mile; Core range120ft and Instantaneous. No boundary shape or center rule is supplied.
options: Select one actual plane identity plus a fixed local one-mile region, explicitly reconciling120ft placement range.
Treat one mile as target range, silently reduce ALL to one portal, or close all planes.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend NEW fixed spherical area centered on a legally placed point within120ft, with whole-connection endpoint predicates stated. Include inaccessible/hidden connections without granting a locator. An undefined plane name fails designation without inventing identity.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual portals, Planar Window, exile cells and long-term compulsion have distinct crossing/information/source relationships. Close connections does not define what counts.
options: Define an exact connection taxonomy and apply ALL qualifying connections to the selected plane; distinguish existing effects from ongoing links.
End every spell involving a planar creature or classify only visible doorways.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend decide real transit apertures, scrying windows, telepathy or persistent summon tethers individually from actual sources. Do not unsummon a body merely because it previously arrived, sever a soul, erase an existing plane or promote every sustained effect into a connection.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The verb close and Instantaneous can mean a one-time closure; a continuing prohibition against new connections would be new power.
options: One-time atomic closure of qualifying existing connections; later independent opening remains possible.
A separately authored continuing seal with explicit duration, concentration and reopening limits.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend one-time closure unless joint review chooses and labels a finite ongoing ward. Preserve the full one-mile/all-connections benefit. Do not accidentally turn instantaneous closure into permanent global prevention or silently pause independent clocks.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Closing during a genuine transit or exile ending can strand, split or delete bodies unless ordering is explicit; ordinary Ready resolves after its completed trigger.
options: Finish committed atomic crossings, then close later use; explicitly adjudicate true interruption sources and mandatory endings.
Bisect a body or convert ordinary Ready into a mid-transit interrupt.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend deterministic event order, source-specific terminal settlement and exact metadata retention. Decide whether a terminal Banishment return is a sealable connection or a scoped mandatory transition; do not imply the spell inherits or overrides its exception silently.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Banish up to3 extraplanar creatures with CHA resistance. Planar Binding uses explicit source/current travel provenance, while Planar Barrier uses explicit extraplanar or established native relationship; these predicates are separately scoped.
options: Explicitly select a source-local extraplanar predicate and preserve missing/hidden qualification behavior.
Treat outsider, summoned, Elemental, Fiend, native and extraplanar as interchangeable.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain all three target opportunities and independent CHA saves, with an expressly selected predicate supported by actual body/source/plane records. Unknown native identity is not a discovered fact. Do not globally unify already accepted distinct predicates.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No temporary/native/home destination, duration, concentration or return rule accompanies the printed banishment. Ordinary Banishment uses a generated temporary cell; Banish Elemental adopts that only through an explicit extension.
options: Explicitly extend the bounded exile-cell contract with a selected duration and three independent records.
Send to a proved actual origin destination using a new complete return/placement contract.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend the narrow explicit cell extension if it preserves intended banishment without naming unproved native planes; retain Core Instantaneous as original evidence and disclose NEW continuing lifecycle. If a true origin-return interpretation is chosen, require actual provenance, safe deterministic placement and explicit failure behavior rather than inferred lore.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Up to3 selected extraplanar creatures can differ in saves, eligibility, defenses, carried bodies, hard-control history and destination validity.
options: Resolve independent named targets in stable order after one paid cast, preserving each lawful successful/failed result.
Abort/refund all results whenever one target is unknown or silently substitute another hidden eligible target.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit shared versus per-target application ownership, hard-control admissions, independent closure and suppression. No retargeting on a hidden failure, bundled creature-as-cargo trick, inventory duplication or new target fact disclosure.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Rulebook/catalog says permanently bound to the Veiled Expanse unless freed; retained Core says Shadowfell. Original Cosmology describes Veiled Expanse; current bounded plane review forbids identity merges from theme.
options: Use Veiled Expanse as the spell’s explicit authored destination label while preserving the Core conflict; do not equate realms globally.
Hold destination-dependent outcomes until the owner settles the specific naming conflict.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend source-first joint disposition before authored destination use. If the first option is selected, it is only this spell’s source reconciliation, not proof Shadowfell is Veiled Expanse or a new cosmology map. No wider realm merger is authorized.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Permanently bound to a plane unless freed, with Until Dispelled, does not define whether the body moves there immediately, only becomes unable to leave, or gains a remote tether.
options: Choose explicit planar relocation plus a persistent escape restriction with full arrival rules.
Choose a binding record whose first lawful arrival establishes confinement, with disclosed current-world effect.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require joint selection of the intended full benefit, initial resistance/hard admission, body eligibility and exact release condition. Do not replace permanent-until-freed with an arbitrary short timer or claim passive tethering achieves immediate banishment.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Until Dispelled/unless freed implies a genuine release route but names no freeing effect, suppression consequence, return destination or recasting policy.
options: Define eligible actual dispel/release predicates, suppression behavior and whether release returns the body or only lifts the restriction.
Make it impossible to free, allow any generic restoration automatically, or grant tactical destination choice without source.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend persistent same-identity binding until a real selected ending; explicitly distinguish source suppression from true dispel. Specify actual-caster death, replacement, travel blockers and remaining occupants/cargo without deleting the binding’s history or inventing a free round trip.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original Veiled Expanse imagery does not establish that every occupant is dead, native, soulless or already hunted. Owner Hunt exceptions are extremely rare Divine/Abyssal intervention, not routine planar magic.
options: Keep the actual living/dead body, source lifetime and independent Hunt/recovery rules; no soul relocation is inferred.
Treat exile as death, rewrite origin/soul identity, or create a repeatable Hunt escape.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend preserve all real HP/death/research/taint/source records and inventory provenance. Determine any legitimate ordinary-world survival needs from actual creature/realm content; do not invent a universal environmental hazard or sanctuary from evocative lore.

futureCaseRequirements: At least two full deterministic cases per spell after choices, with actual class access/resources/source actors/target predicates, RNG, geometry, clocks, object custody and exact final records.
Demiplane: create/reopen actual room, multiple bodies/items and lawful independent transfers; source/door suppression and closure during atomic crossing with nonempty old space.
Maze: real full-body labyrinth movement/escape, actual save/hard history and clocks; independent visitor/summon, death or mandatory anatomy change and finite closure/blocked placement.

Planar Seal: one-mile mixed connection graph to selected plane, hidden endpoints without locator, real concurrent crossing and unaffected other-plane connections; distinguish one-time closure from new future source creation.
Seal of Banishment: three separately eligible/resisting/unqualified bodies, each source-local predicate and hard history, legal custody, exact independent endings and no invented origin world.

Gloom Bind: resolved source-naming premise and genuine arrival/binding, persistent imprisonment and real freeing/suppression; actual corpse/body expiry, cargo and Hunt restrictions without automatic soul/history changes.
No source-only creature, undefined plane identity, invented travel provider or isolated reference model supplies runtime/semantic evidence beyond its disclosed inputs.
